item.title: The chroot Technique - a Swiss army multitool for Linux systems
item.description: Ever ran into a Linux box that just won’t boot, even after making sure that BIOS settings are OK and that no major hardware errors are at hand? Then you need to know about the chroot technique, which can be a real life saver. For example, I managed to repair a Nanopore GridION device this way the other week, after the official method of re-installing it via an .iso file failed, which reminded me to make the effort of documenting these steps.
